title: 24-Layer HfO2/SiO2 Stack with Relaxed Bounds and Coordinate Perturbation
scientific_hypothesis: Relaxing thickness bounds by ±10% and applying deterministic coordinate-wise perturbation of ±4.0 nm to worst-performing 25% of candidates will increase valid candidate density above 10 and escape local symmetry clusters, leading to improved best_target_score.
design_principle: Maintain the verified 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 topology from prior iterations while expanding the search space through bound relaxation and symmetry-breaking perturbations to explore untrapped interior regions of the parameter space.
proposed_topology: 24 finite layers: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate
design_variables: thickness bounds relaxed by ±10% from prior iteration
coordinate-wise perturbation ±4.0 nm on worst 25% candidates
manufacturing_considerations: HfO2 and SiO2 materials only per user constraint
thickness bounds relaxed to improve fabrication tolerance margin
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflectance bands
expected_advantages: Higher valid candidate density enables better statistical sampling
Perturbation breaks local symmetry to escape suboptimal minima
Maintains proven 24-layer topology from prior successful iterations
known_risks: Relaxed bounds may increase total coating thickness beyond practical limits
Perturbation may temporarily degrade best_target_score during exploration phase
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dielectric coating on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2(1)|SiO2(2)|HfO2(3)|SiO2(4)|HfO2(5)|SiO2(6)|HfO2(7)|SiO2(8)|HfO2(9)|SiO2(10)|HfO2(11)|SiO2(12)|HfO2(13)|SiO2(14)|HfO2(15)|SiO2(16)|HfO2(17)|SiO2(18)|HfO2(19)|SiO2(20)|HfO2(21)|SiO2(22)|HfO2(23)|SiO2(24). Initialize thicknesses from baseline values [127.0, 100.0, 121.0, 100.0, 124.0, 178.0, 96.0, 153.0, 116.0, 152.0, 111.0, 101.0, 140.0, 100.0, 116.0, 144.0, 124.0, 100.0, 117.0, 166.0, 104.0, 100.0, 116.0, 108.0] nm. Relax all thickness bounds by ±10% from baseline bounds of 80-400 nm. Apply deterministic coordinate-wise perturbation of ±4.0 nm to worst-performing 25% of candidates each iteration. Use coherent smatrix solver across combined 300-1700 nm wavelength range. Optimize for mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band and mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band simultaneously. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: low transmission in 300-450 nm; low reflection in 1000-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30; materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Per feedback directive: relax thickness bounds by ±10% to recover valid candidate density above 10, apply deterministic coordinate-wise perturbation of ±4.0 nm to worst-performing 25% of candidates to break local symmetry clusters.
